summary: Investment Director candidate with ~7 years across institutional investment research, portfolio risk analytics, and alternatives-focused due diligence at Moody's Analytics and Ortec Finance. Depth in VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, macroeconomic scenario analysis, and LDI across multi-asset mandates, with sign-off authority on outputs for portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Fluent in Python and stochastic modelling; CFA charterholder with dual MSc in Financial Modelling and Chemical Engineering.

experience.employer: Moody's Analytics — Asset Management & Buy-Side Solutions

roles.title: Asst. Director — Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Investment Analysis & Portfolio Oversight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement ($50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions.
Validated derivatives valuation outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, ensuring consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream investment and capital processes.

sections.heading: Scenario Analysis & Executive Reporting
bullets: Led design of a multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking visibility across investment horizons.

Prepared analytical summaries and periodic briefs for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready narratives.
Escalated outputs lacking economic defensibility, serving as escalation point on client-critical analytical issues for Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and SQL analytics pipelines; deployed agentic-AI workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) reducing development cycle time ~30-40% on comparable modules.

Led onboarding for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM analytics platforms; translated investment-team requirements into structured development requests and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Coordinated the full implementation lifecycle across multiple stakeholders, migrating all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform on schedule.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and governance documentation in multi-stakeholder environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators to assess macroeconomic, interest-rate, and funding-volatility exposures under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered investment and ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors across all major asset classes, covering duration, currency, and inflation exposures.
Presented investment findings to investment committees on-site, advising on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside major investment-product types and economic variables; led onboarding and the study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three.
